semiconductor_relevance: High — ECHINT specializes in advanced panel level packaging and testing services for integrated circuits.
summary: Chengdu ECHINT IC Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of advanced panel level packaging and testing services in the semiconductor industry. The company offers a wide range of bespoke packaging solutions, leveraging cutting-edge technology to serve various sectors including mobile, 5G, IoT, AI, and automotive electronics.
capabilities: Integration of 2D FO, 2.xD FO, FO PoP, FCPLP

regional_presence.China: ECHINT is located in Chengdu, China, and is part of the Beijing ESWIN Technology Group.
